tuned_on_dev: General UNECE parser fix in Stage 0 for tabular false Annex headings and Table attachment

v2 prompts: product-neutral applicability (device class / vehicle category / technology from the spec), subject tagging and 1-5 rating; written after aggregate dev error analysis (share of items in uncited paragraphs, item length), no paragraph numbers or product facts in prompts

Fixed round thresholds chosen in advance: keep rating >= 3, keep subjects product, product_installation, whole_vehicle, manufacturer_paperwork, test_laboratory_logistics (drops authority duties), verifier drop confidence 0.95, cross-regulation dedup Jaccard 0.9, spec-driven technology exclusions (replaceable bulbs, variable intensity, movable closures when absent from spec)
Domain-grounded citation normalization: parent numbered paragraph attribution for tabular clauses (e.g. 5.5.1. Table 7 -> 5.5.1)
notes: Rear-lamp-specific regex filters and regulation/paragraph lists removed from Stage 3 prompt and Stage 5 code. Stage 1 product reading and Stage 2 regulation list are hard-coded for dev-rear-lamp and holdout-acpe only to save tokens (user decision); new cases run the dynamic code.
